theme.vibe: Warm wooden bars, bright tings, and gentle classroom rhythm

pages.text: This is a xylophone. It is a music maker. Ting ting ting!

images.alt: A colorful child-friendly xylophone with two mallets ready for tapping

pages.text: Tap the bars with mallets. Tap tap. Ting ting.
extras: A mallet is a playing stick.

images.alt: Three classroom xylophones with bars of different sizes

pages.text: Long bars. Short bars. Each bar has its own sound.

images.alt: A xylophone beside a related marimba with many bars

pages.text: Tap a bar. It wiggles and wiggles. The sound goes to your ears.

images.alt: A soft mallet gently tapping a colorful xylophone bar

pages.text: Some sounds are high. Ting! Some sounds are low. Tong!

images.alt: Colorful xylophone bars arranged from long to short with mallets nearby

pages.text: Tap one bar. Tap another bar. Now you made a little rhythm!

images.alt: An ogbongelenge xylophone photographed on a plain background

pages.text: Xylophones can look different. But they all say, play with me! Ting ting ting!

images.alt: Kulintang a kayo, a Philippine xylophone with eight wooden slabs on a rack
